t: The one outcome he sought refuge from by name
a: أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي أَنْتَ الْحَىُّ الَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ وَالْجِنُّ وَالإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ
p: Aʿūdhu bi-ʿizzatika lā ilāha illā anta an tuḍillanī. Anta-l-ḥayyu-lladhī lā yamūtu wa-l-jinnu wa-l-insu yamūtūn
m: I seek refuge in Your might, there is no god but You, from being let astray. You are the Living who does not die, while jinn and men die.
